title: What is the price of Al Raffa AC repair?
desc: The cost depends on the type of AC, the issue and the required parts. The price is clearly stated after inspection.

title: How many times should I service my AC in Al Raffa?
desc: We suggest getting your AC serviced once every 6 months. This ensures it functions properly and prevents unexpected issues.

title: Why is my AC not cooling properly?
desc:
These issues are the common causes. It will be discovered through a check-up
  • Dirty filters
  • Low gas
  • Blocked coils
  • Compressor
  • Blown AC capacitor

title: Do you provide AC services for apartments in Al Raffa?

title: Why is there water leakage on the AC?
desc: The typical causes of water leakage are when the drain pipe is blocked, the coils freeze, or the filters become clogged.

title: Can AC cleaning improve cooling?
desc: Yes, it sure can. Cleaning removes the dust and allows for improved airflow. In the process, the AC cools down faster.

title: Do you provide same-day AC repair in Al Raffa?

desc: We repair Daikin, LG, Samsung, O General, Mitsubishi, Carrier, York, Trane, Gree, Panasonic and many more.

title: What is included in AC maintenance?
desc: This includes filter cleaning, checking coils, clearing drains, testing thermostats and a complete performance test.

title: Is an Annual Maintenance Contract worth it?
desc: Yes, an AMC helps keep your AC in good condition and prevents expensive repairs all year long.

title: What are the reasons for my air conditioning unit making weird sounds?
desc: It's typically because of loose parts, fan problems, or dust in the fan. A technician will be able to tell you for certain.

title: Is a dirty AC good or bad for health?
desc: Yes, it can release dust and mould into the air that may trigger allergic reactions and breathing problems.
